# Repair cafe plans with a boundary

Agreed six repair cafe dates for next year and kept August empty. The small schedule fits the volunteers who actually offered time. [[Repair ideas]] retains referral contacts and stopping rules beside the booking plan. A service can be dependable because its edges are clear, rather than because somebody always agrees to cover another date.
